channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Airlines roll out support measures as Vietnam’s Lien Khuong airport closes for 6-month upgrade
item.description: Vietnamese airlines have announced a series of support measures for passengers affected by the temporary closure of Lien Khuong International Airport, the key aviation gateway to Da Lat in the Central Highlands region.

item.title: Australia economy picks up speed in Q4 but headwinds intensifying
item.description: SYDNEY -- Australia's economy grew at the fastest annual pace in almost three years in the December quarter, data showed on Wednesday, a pickup that reignited inflation and required a hike in interest rates to tamp demand down.

item.title: Geopolitical storm leaves isolated Greenlanders hanging by a telecoms thread
item.description: In the Greenlandic village of Kapisillit, a crisis meeting has just begun.

item.title: Amazon launches 15 minute grocery delivery in 'priority' market Brazil
item.description: SAO PAULO - Amazon launched its Amazon Now service in Brazil on Tuesday, pledging to deliver essentials and groceries in 15 minutes, with its country head calling the Latin American country one of the firm's top priorities for new investments.

item.title: Vietnam’s Vung Tau ‘banh mi’ shop shut after suspected food poisoning
item.description: Authorities in Vung Tau Ward, Ho Chi Minh City have ordered a local ‘banh mi’ shop to suspend operations after several customers were hospitalized with suspected food poisoning.

item.title: UN warns 200,000 more Afghan children face acute malnutrition in 2026
item.description: Hundreds of thousands more children face acute malnutrition in Afghanistan this year amid a hunger crisis exacerbated by foreign aid cuts and violence on the border with Pakistan, a U.N. official said on Tuesday.

item.title: American family pays $3,000 each to wash dishes, catch fish in Vietnam
item.description: A family of four from the United States spent some US$3,000 per person on a 10- to 12-day year-end journey through Vietnam, choosing not luxury resorts or crowded tourist attractions, but the rhythms of everyday rural life.

item.title: Vietnam suspends tours to Middle East conflict zones
item.description: Amid escalating tensions in the Middle East, the Vietnam National Authority of Tourism has issued a directive requiring travel companies to halt outbound tours to conflict-affected areas.

item.title: Vietnamese group proposes $10bn coastal complex in Ca Mau
item.description: Xuan Thien Group has proposed investing in an industrial-agricultural complex integrated with urban, tourism, and energy components, with a total value of approximately VND260 trillion (US$10 billion) in the coastal area of Ca Mau, the only locality in Vietnam that borders both the East Vietnam Sea and the Gulf of Thailand.

item.title: Vietnam’s Vingroup proposes 3,000MW offshore wind farm in Ca Mau for energy exports
item.description: Vietnamese conglomerate Vingroup has proposed a major offshore wind power project in the southern province of Ca Mau, seeking approval to develop a 3,000MW facility aimed at exporting electricity.
